questions.text: What comes next: January, March, May, ___?
questions.why: The pattern skips every other month: January, March, May, then July.

questions.text: A World Cup group has four teams, each playing the others once. How many games does each team play?
questions.why: Each team plays the other three once.

questions.text: Which word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?
questions.why: Add the two letters E and R to SHORT and you get SHORTER.

questions.text: What is the next letter in this sequence: O, T, T, F, F, S, S, E, ___?
questions.why: These are the initials of One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight, so next is N for Nine.

questions.text: The server leads 40-15. How many points have been played in the game?
questions.why: 40 means three points won and 15 means one: 3 + 1 = 4.

questions.text: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be 100 days from now?
questions.why: 100 days is 14 weeks and 2 days, and two days after Wednesday is Friday.

questions.text: Six glasses in a row: the first three are full, the next three empty. Moving only ONE glass, make them alternate full and empty. Which glass do you move?
answers: Pour the second into the fifth
questions.why: Pour glass 2 into glass 5 and put it back: the glasses then go full, empty, full, empty, full, empty.

questions.text: How many different letters in EDINBURGH do not appear anywhere in GLASGOW?
questions.why: EDINBURGH has nine different letters (E, D, I, N, B, U, R, G, H), and only G is in GLASGOW, leaving 8.

questions.text: Using only 3s (penalties) and 5s (tries), what is the largest total you can't make?
questions.why: 8 = 5 + 3, 9 = 3 + 3 + 3 and 10 = 5 + 5; adding 3s then covers everything higher, but 7 can't be made.

questions.text: Which planet in our Solar System is the only one not named after a god from Greek or Roman mythology?
questions.why: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune are all gods. Earth comes from an Old English word for the ground.

questions.text: In a family, each girl has as many brothers as sisters, but each boy has twice as many sisters as brothers. How many children are in the family?
questions.why: Four girls and three boys: a girl has 3 sisters and 3 brothers; a boy has 2 brothers and 4 sisters.
